title: Researcher friend in touch with Eric Henry Wang's daughter

tellings.quote: I could say definitively he was real cuz I have a researcher friend who's in touch with his daughter now.

plain: Eric Henry Wang, a man linked in these stories to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio in the 1950s, was a real person, Michels says, because a researcher friend of his is now in touch with Wang's daughter. Michels tells this himself, from what his friend told him, and says it lets him state "definitively he was real", though that only shows the man existed, not what is said about his work.
